dedupe_keys.name: cesi nanterre nr3 modular teaching building sensor data 2023 2024

description: This dataset describes the monitored operation of CESI’s NR3 teaching building in Nanterre, France, during 1 June 2023–31 May 2024. The roughly 220-square-metre building uses sixteen shipping containers and houses classrooms, offices and technical spaces. More than 150 sensors and actuators supply thirteen CSV tables covering indoor and outdoor conditions, electricity, heat-pump operation, ventilation, windows, doors and lighting. Zenodo provides free CC BY 4.0 access and also lists an example missing-data code archive. Coverage is one occupied modular building, not representative French teaching infrastructure. Sampling intervals are not established by the short repository metadata, and its referenced readme spreadsheet and map are absent from the current file inventory. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating coupled building-system and occupant-control simulations. model-energyplus is a related building model. No CSV or example archive was fetched, so missing-data rates, variable units and direct model import remain unchecked.
name: CESI Nanterre NR3 modular teaching-building sensor data, 2023–2024
